message: 特攻天使

name: Synn
message: 「Haa... Haa... Wait... I said, wait up...」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait for me, Loloootte!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, what is it?」

name: Synn
message: 「You just bolted out of nowhere. You really startled me.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That chairwoman is out there working her hardest for us. I simply cannot sit quietly in the Student Council room and wait!」
I didn't realize Lolotte was this proactive. When I first saw her, I thought she was a quiet girl.
Grr... I can't let myself fall behind either.

name: Synn
message: 「Got it. I'll tag along with you, Lolotte. So, where are we going?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Where indeed?」

name: Synn
message: 「You ran out without any destination in mind...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Acting purely on impulse is no good, is it?」
She stuck her tongue out playfully and gave her own forehead a light bonk with her fist.

name: Shio
message: 「Oh, if it isn't Synn-dono and Lolotte-dono.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, hello there. Heading back from club activities?」

name: Shio
message: 「Indeed.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Sniff, sniff. You smell wonderful~」

name: Shio
message: 「Training produces a great deal of sweat, so I took the liberty of cleansing myself.」

name: Synn
message: 「It's true. That's a really nice shampoo scent.」

name: Shio
message: 「P-Please refrain from such... vulgar behavior...」

name: Paqy
message: 「I totally figured you'd be the type to scrub down vigorously with plain bar soap.」

name: Shio
message: 「D-D-Did you come here just to tease this one?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh, that reminds me! There's something we'd love for you to help us with too, Miss Shrine Maiden!」

name: Shio
message: 「With this one?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「We're going to put on a huge event involving all of Ryuusei Town!」

name: Shio
message: 「Oh-ho, and what sort of thing might that be?」

name: Synn
message: 「For our annual Charity Bazaar, you see. I'm thinking about having folks from the shopping district participate too.」

name: Shio
message: 「What a worldly affair that sounds to be. Might it not tarnish the traditions of this academy?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm... You think so?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If we're going to do it anyway, wouldn't it be better to make it fun? Let's take on some new challenges!」

name: Shio
message: 「Hmph. Truly, 'the wise man adapts like a leopard, while the petty man merely changes his face,' as they say.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's too hard, I don't really get it.\s06」

name: Synn
message: 「Does that mean... you're agreeing to go along with it?」

name: Shio
message: 「Hahaha. Governance is not my duty in the first place, so I merely follow whatever my liege decides.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Don't say that--let's have fun together! You're one of our companions at this academy too, Miss Shrine Maiden.」

name: Shio
message: 「Lolotte-dono...」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, exactly. I don't think it'll succeed unless everyone pitches in to liven things up.」

name: Shio
message: 「...As you wish. If someone such as myself will suffice, I shall hasten to your side at any time.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Thank you very much!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah... come to think of it, your family runs a shrine, right, Shio?」

name: Shio
message: 「Indeed we do.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'd really love for your family to participate too.」

name: Shio
message: 「Hmm... I shall inform my honorable grandfather. That this is a once-in-a-lifetime reformation to revitalize our town!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Way to blow it out of proportion.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Blowing it out of proportion is completely fine!」

name: Synn
message: 「Nothing's officially decided yet, so it's still just tentative. Still, we're short on time, so we need to get things moving behind the scenes--」

name: Shio
message: 「What nonsense do you speak? A warrior never goes back on their word.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's right! Besides, I've already gone and blabbed about it to everyone in class!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaat, since when?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If it ends up getting canceled now, what will everyone do to me... *shiver, shiver*」
W-We have to get this approved no matter what.

name: Shio
message: 「As the saying goes, the early bird gets the advantage. I believe Lolotte-dono's actions have inadvertently worked in our favor.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, I thought it would be best for as many people as possible to know about it...」

name: Synn
message: 「You're right. Alright! Let's keep up the outreach campaign together.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Are you sure?」

name: Synn
message: 「Whatever happens, happens.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes!」
Trusting that Helena would bring back good news, we began reaching out to the students.
